main_body: A hide or woven panel stretched in a wooden frame, drawn face-on, with a bottom beam and two short legs below.
top_band: none. Column read from the top: dark brown frame line (rows 0-2), then the golden hide face straight away. No lighter horizontal surface is visible.
evidence: The main body is a tall vertical panel (rows 2-17) seen straight on. The top beam is only a 1-3 row dark outline, not a surface. The bottom beam (rows 17-21) is a mid-brown band with a slightly lighter top edge about 1-2 rows deep, which is a rim and not a readable top face. The hide has no inset or eave shadow. Legs show only their fronts. Nothing reads as a horizontal surface seen from above, so this matches the red front-elevation guide.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood, which is good. The hide has about 3-4 yellow tones and a teal pattern with a few dark spots. There are scattered texture dots, but large patches of one yellow are flat fills. The wood beam has only 2-3 steps. The stall and well references have 5-6 steps per material and more grain, and this piece looks thinner and flatter next to them.
